notes.title: Cheerleaders – Over 2,800 renders already!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Development on [i]Cheerleaders[/i] is moving fast, and the game is growing bigger with every update. Here are some fun stats to give you an idea of the scale so far:[/p][p]➡️ [b]Pilot[/b]: 1,400 renders and 6,600 lines of code
➡️ [b]Season 1 (so far)[/b]: 1,400 renders and 5,400 lines of code[/p][p][b]Grand total so far[/b]:
➡️ Over [b]2,800 renders[/b]
➡️ Over [b]12,000 lines of code[/b][/p][p]And this is only the beginning—Season 1 already rivals the Pilot in size, and we’re not even done yet![/p][p][b]What’s next?[/b]
The [b]full Steam release will happen once Season 1 is complete[/b], which we expect to be [b]in a few months[/b]. Until then, we’ll keep sharing development progress and sneak peeks here.[/p][p]Don’t forget to [b]wishlist Cheerleaders[/b] to get notified the moment it goes live! 💜[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620082/1375d4af47f69d7d0b6f1bc1077bd2db4cf31160.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620082/4f388502f0575ad2c41dcdf49e23da7fcf70d4d1.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620082/cfaff17695727aef4d1b2d15de204d1ca6833019.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620082/8bd7138bc8cbc5cc9c08409801282b352aa8f523.jpg"][/img][/p]
